numeric_input: Untransformed published legacy18 and identity33; first-arrival imputation and scaling only
scaler: Common original LaBSE in eval mode, before updates, only first-arrival public inputs; median fill and population mean/std fixed thereafter; float64 affine then float32 head
text_deduplication: Unique text per account and field; equal original-text weight. Share exact text encoding within one branch only.
chunking: Existing single-LaBSE chunk_text_exact; exact character reconstruction; no maximum chunk count or truncation
forward_precision: bfloat16 autocast encoder, float32 pooling and six aggregates
current_batch: One complete K28 world, all 378 edges, one mean BCE
replay_sampling: Uniform without replacement among retained edges per update
loss: mean_BCE(current) + mean_BCE(history); missing history contributes zero; sequential backward then one clip/update
memory_selection: Independent 64-bit random priority, arrival ordinal breaks ties; longest fitting prefix of the global random order, stop at first nonfitting edge. Cost-dependent inclusion, not uniform reservoir.
memory_record: 51 raw float64 values, one label byte, public endpoint IDs and full per-field unique redacted texts; no cross-edge deduplication
memory_accounting: 1024 actual serialized header bytes including padding and RNG/cutoff/stage state; 20 entry-header bytes plus each complete edge payload
memory_update: Once in unique canonical current-edge order after completing each stage; only prior-stage memory may train
randomness: Independent memory selection/replay RNG; stateless per-order/stage/epoch/step current/history dropout seeds. Current branch shape/order paired across sequential and ER.
state: One physical first-stage fit per arrival order; sequential and ER inherit identical encoder/head/nonempty optimizer. Cumulative resets original encoder/head and empty AdamW at each arrived prefix for two epochs; same first-stage scaler.
development: Fixed original 500-world candidate set; re-encode both endpoints at each changed checkpoint, publish/reload complete scores before separate Windows binary-label evaluation. Reuse unchanged metric functions; no qrels or Audit A/B reads.
claim_boundary: Within-new-representation comparisons only; random same-source arrivals are not domains or real chronology. No sole-unfreezing attribution, established forgetting, new selector contribution or real-market validation.
